n = 33146799
claimed = [3, 7, 1578419]

def factorize(m):
    f = []
    d = 2
    while d * d <= m:
        while m % d == 0:
            f.append(d)
            m //= d
        d += 1 if d == 2 else 2
    if m > 1:
        f.append(m)
    return f

def is_prime(p):
    if p < 2:
        return False
    d = 2
    while d * d <= p:
        if p % d == 0:
            return False
        d += 1 if d == 2 else 2
    return True

fac = factorize(n)
prod = 1
for p in fac:
    prod *= p
claimed_prod = 1
for p in claimed:
    claimed_prod *= p

print("n =", n)
print("full factorization with multiplicity:", fac)
print("product of factorization:", prod, "matches n:", prod == n)
print("distinct primes:", sorted(set(fac)))
print("claimed:", claimed)
print("product of claimed:", claimed_prod)
print("each claimed is prime:", [(p, is_prime(p)) for p in claimed])
print("each claimed divides n:", [(p, n % p == 0) for p in claimed])

if sorted(set(fac)) == sorted(claimed) and all(is_prime(p) for p in claimed) and claimed_prod == n:
    print("CHECK PASS")
elif sorted(set(fac)) == sorted(claimed):
    print("CHECK PASS (distinct prime set matches)")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
